purpose: Prevent a byte-valid but stale Unity 4K render packet from being scored after the persisted benchmark scene, recursive render dependencies, project render settings, or formal capture/tonemap recipe changes. This is provenance/readiness enforcement only and awards zero Visual Fidelity points.

enforcementBridge.existingProvenanceInvariant: QualityBlockRenderEvidenceProvenanceQA requires render_capture_receipt.renderProducedByUnity=true before bound evidence/template/scoring can validate.
enforcementBridge.staleCandidateAction: Set render_capture_receipt.renderProducedByUnity=false, delete the candidate seal, and write a reason receipt. Native 4K recapture is required.
enforcementBridge.whyFailClosed: Old PNG/crop bytes may remain internally valid and pixel-exact but cannot represent the current visual candidate after render-affecting state changes.

candidateFingerprint.projectRenderSettings: SHA-256 for every canonical path above
candidateFingerprint.formalRenderRecipe: SHA-256 for every canonical path above
candidateFingerprint.latestInputWriteUtc: Maximum file/meta write UTC across active-scene recursive dependencies plus canonical settings/recipe inputs
candidateFingerprint.combinedDigest: SHA-256 over canonical scene identity/hash/dependency hash and sorted canonical settings/recipe byte hashes

freshCaptureSealRequirements.receiptImportTrigger: AssetPostprocessor observes Assets/QA/render_capture_receipt.json after the existing receipt writer refreshes the AssetDatabase.

resealAttackClosed.scenario: Scene/material/shader/settings/recipe changes after capture, then Seal Existing Native 4K Capture is called without Camera.Render.
resealAttackClosed.expectedResult: FAIL_CLOSED because 4k_capture_manifest.generatedUtc predates the advanced candidate epoch/latest tracked input write; the newly written receipt is immediately invalidated instead of binding stale PNGs to the new candidate.
